Check a district's admin-1 pairing is stable within the Admin sheet itself

Source: R/0_data_quality_checks.R
check_admin_pairing_consistency.Rd

Pre-merge half of the old (still-existing, still used post-merge by new_countdown()'s Tier B) check_district_consistency() – this half only ever needed the Admin sheet: a district's adminlevel_1 pairing can only vary across the merged data if the Admin sheet itself lists that district more than once with different values, so checking the raw sheet directly loses no signal.

Usage

check_admin_pairing_consistency(admin_data)

Arguments

admin_data

The raw Admin sheet (parts[[admin_sheet_name]], pre-rename – still has first_admin_level, not adminlevel_1).
